legend: There are balls of n%%ZSMJ0%% different colors; the number of balls of the i%%ZSMJ1%%-th color is ai%%ZSMJ2%%.
The balls can be combined into groups. Each group should contain at most 2%%ZSMJ3%% balls, and no more than 1%%ZSMJ4%% ball of each color.

Consider all 2n%%ZSMJ5%% sets of colors. For a set of colors, let's denote its value as the minimum number of groups the balls of those colors can be distributed into. For example, if there are three colors with 3%%ZSMJ6%%, 1%%ZSMJ7%% and 7%%ZSMJ8%% balls respectively, they can be combined into 7%%ZSMJ9%% groups (and not less than 7%%ZSMJ10%%), so the value of that set of colors is 7%%ZSMJ11%%.
Your task is to calculate the sum of values over all 2n%%ZSMJ12%% possible sets of colors. Since the answer may be too large, print it modulo 998244353%%ZSMJ13%%.
input: The first line contains a single integer n%%ZSMJ14%% (1≤n≤5000%%ZSMJ15%%) — the number of colors.
The second line contains n%%ZSMJ16%% integers a1,a2,…,an%%ZSMJ17%% (1≤ai≤5000%%ZSMJ18%%) — the number of balls of the i%%ZSMJ19%%-th color.
Additional constraint on input: the total number of balls doesn't exceed 5000%%ZSMJ20%%.
output: Print a single integer — the sum of values of all 2n%%ZSMJ21%% sets of colors, taken modulo 998244353%%ZSMJ22%%.
note: Consider the first example. There are 8%%ZSMJ23%% sets of colors:
for the empty set, its value is 0%%ZSMJ24%%;
for the set {1}%%ZSMJ25%%, its value is 1%%ZSMJ26%%;
for the set {2}%%ZSMJ27%%, its value is 1%%ZSMJ28%%;
for the set {3}%%ZSMJ29%%, its value is 2%%ZSMJ30%%;
for the set {1,2}%%ZSMJ31%%, its value is 1%%ZSMJ32%%;
for the set {1,3}%%ZSMJ33%%, its value is 2%%ZSMJ34%%;
for the set {2,3}%%ZSMJ35%%, its value is 2%%ZSMJ36%%;
for the set {1,2,3}%%ZSMJ37%%, its value is 2%%ZSMJ38%%.
So, the sum of values over all 2n%%ZSMJ39%% sets of colors is 11%%ZSMJ40%%.
